newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended easier on profit-taking in brisk trading at the half-year's end despite the U.S. FOMC meeting looming this week, dealers said.
Conf futures initially moved higher to 121.30 in busy dealing. There was good turnover in government bonds, with demand seen for medium- to long-dated paaper, one dealer said.
"But the follow-through buying is missing," he said. "Profit-taking set in too quickly." This brought prices to the day's lows in sometimes hectic dealing.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up six at 113.60
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 off nine at 98.47.
